name: TruthScan
description: Use TruthScan's MCP to immediately determine, with 99% accuracy, if an image is AI-generated, photoshopped, or real.

_published_faq.name: How do I add TruthScan to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add TruthScan to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://truthscan.com/api/mcp. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the TruthScan MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: TruthScan provides these MCP tools: create_image_upload_url and detect_image.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to TruthScan?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 17, 2026, alternatives to TruthScan in productivity on the Manufact MCP catalog include Autodesk Product Help, BoardWise, FlagStat, Keenable Web Search, and PomoDial.
TruthScan requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
TruthScan is developed by TruthScan. It is listed as community on the Claude connector directory.
